/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.links = []; self.dates = []; self.headings = 0
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'a': self.links.append(attrs.get('href'))
        if tag == 'time': self.dates.append(attrs.get('datetime'))
        if tag == 'h1': self.headings += 1
page = Page()
source = Path('index.html').read_text()
page.feed(source)
assert page.links == ['tel:+15035550142']
assert page.dates == ['2027-07-01', '2027-07-21', '2027-07-22']
assert page.headings == 1
assert 'Crumb & Co.' in source
assert '503-555-0142' in source
print('HTML parsed; bakery name, closure dates, reopening date, and phone link verified.')
print('Single self-contained file; no external assets or scripts.')
PY"
